target.metadata_seen_before_freeze: filenames and file sizes only; paper-level prior art that glycans form a nonspecific kinetic barrier is known

janus_prior: cross-modal evidence must not be double-counted
question: Do two experimental exclusion-rate projections exhibit a shared localized departure from the supplied simulation, indicating a missing regime/state variable that an aggregate fit would obscure?

frozen_parser.key_rule: use exact shared non-outcome key column names across all three files. If exactly one common numeric key exists, use it as ordered x. If no unique common numeric key exists, PARSE_FAIL.
frozen_parser.outcome_rule: in each file, after removing key/index-like columns, require exactly one numeric measurement column; otherwise PARSE_FAIL.
frozen_parser.join: inner join exact x values present in all three files; require >=8 joined points; no manual point removal

cross_modal_requirement.reason: a single assay disagreement cannot promote a shared missing-regime claim

first_break_detector.scale: 1.4826*MAD of baseline residuals; if zero use full-series residual MAD only as a predeclared fallback
first_break_detector.candidate: earliest post-baseline point with |R-baseline_median| >= 2.5*scale AND cross-modal directional agreement
first_break_detector.persistence: same residual sign and cross-modal directional agreement for candidate plus next 2 joined points
first_break_detector.severity: minimum standardized absolute residual over the persistent 3-point run

null.method: permute Simulated measurement values across fixed x while preserving both experimental series and all marginals
null.enumeration: exact if N!<=100000; otherwise 10000 deterministic SHA256 permutations
null.score: maximum 3-point persistent severity under the same detector
null.pass: native first-break exists and native severity strictly exceeds 95th percentile null

claim_if_pass: Within the supplied processed data, there is a cross-modally supported localized regime where both experimental exclusion-rate observables depart from the supplied simulation more coherently than expected under x-label randomization.

required_next: identify physical variable without post-hoc overfit
